snippet.title: Medieval Lands -  Wishlist on Steam! - New Indie MMORPG
snippet.description:
Heya! Medieval Lands is finally on Steam for you all to wishlist woohoooo!!!

Please wishlist the game here - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3779750/Medieval_Lands/?beta=0

Thank you very much!

Check out our website here: https://www.medievallands.com/ 😊

Want to support Medieval Lands?
❤️ https://www.paypal.com/donate?hosted_button_id=2PY82W3GYFBVY ⭐
❤️ https://streamlabs.com/sl_id_61d62af3-63d5-3ab9-bf04-ab7d97a343a6/tip ⭐
Thank you for supporting our game!

🔗 Stay Connected with Medieval Lands:
